simple.summary: נְבוּאָה (nᵉbûwʼâh) means a prediction (spoken or written) First listed occurrence: 2Chr 9 29.

definitions.full: H5016. nebuah נְבוּאָה noun masculine prophecy (late: earlier synonym חָזוֺן ); — 1. a. specific and Genuine 2Chr 15:8 . b. False. Neh 6:12 . 2 prophetic writing אֲחִיָּה נְבוּאַת עַלֿ 2Chr 9:29 .
